claims.claim: In the supported project environment, aios_renew.__version__ dynamically resolves to the installed AIOS-renew distribution metadata version via importlib.metadata.version('aios-renew').
src/aios_renew/__init__.py no longer contains an independently maintained stale package-version literal ('0.1.0'), removing the potential for divergence from project metadata.
The smoke test in tests/test_smoke.py validates version consistency against distribution metadata via importlib.metadata.version('aios-renew') rather than asserting a duplicated fixed version string.
pyproject.toml remains unchanged at version 0.1.3, no release or tag was modified, and unrelated package exports and APIs remain unchanged.
